vertebrae.extractors.sklearn
============================

.. py:module:: vertebrae.extractors.sklearn

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Scikit-learn transformer and pipeline extractors.



Classes
-------

.. autoapisummary::

   vertebrae.extractors.sklearn.SklearnExtractor


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:class:: SklearnExtractor(name, pipeline, already_fitted = False, extractor_type = 'unsupervised_fitted', max_dense_bytes = 2000000000, allow_sparse = False)

   Wrap a scikit-learn transformer or pipeline as an extractor.

   :param name: User-facing extractor name.
   :param pipeline: Object exposing `fit`, `transform`, or `fit_transform`.
   :param already_fitted: Whether to skip fitting and call only `transform`.
   :param extractor_type: Extractor family metadata.
   :param max_dense_bytes: Maximum allowed sparse-to-dense conversion size.
   :param allow_sparse: Whether sparse pipeline outputs should be preserved.


   .. py:method:: fit(X, y = None)

      Fit the wrapped scikit-learn object when needed.

      :param X: Input samples.
      :param y: Optional labels.

      :returns: This extractor.



   .. py:method:: transform(X)

      Transform inputs with the wrapped scikit-learn object.

      :param X: Input samples.

      :returns: Dense or sparse numeric embedding matrix.



   .. py:method:: fit_transform(X, y = None)

      Fit the pipeline if needed and transform inputs.

      :param X: Input samples.
      :param y: Optional labels.

      :returns: Dense or sparse numeric embedding matrix.



   .. py:method:: recipe()

      Return a serializable scikit-learn extractor recipe.

      :returns: JSON-compatible recipe dictionary.
